call_counts.note: pruning removes only C.teacher_preds (2 GRU chains); all LSR calls remain. The timed train path reproduces only the two per-iteration LSR sites (B.gate_input + gate_features = 4k=48); the real training step additionally runs LSR_list(fused), gate_target and pbp/pcp LSR, which are unchanged by the pruning.

caveat: Forward-only timing. A full training step also includes LSR_list(fused), losses, backward through the L4 gate, data loading and dev eval; do NOT scale 0.741 s/step by this ratio.
